##########
Honestly considering returning the MorohoScan Nova Smart Scale because the device and app keep losing their Bluetooth connection. It’s frustrating to go through the longer weighing process only to see that the Bluetooth signal is greyed out meaning that the measurements weren’t recorded. This has been happening more and more often.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I started with a RENPHO scale about a year ago, and it has been very helpful, and honestly minimal issues. I was so happy with it that I made the first mistake of purchasing their blood pressure monitor. It seems to read and store locally just fine, but it has given me issues since day 1 with syncing inside the RENPHO app. I chalked this up to my own learning curve, and went ahead and purchased a RENPHO ring to monitor biometrics throughout the day. That worked fine for the first month or two, then the battery life dropped off from lasting me 7+ days to barely making it through the night after charging all day. The ring is more of an expensive novelty, and doesn’t sync well within Apple health, so I just chalk that one up as a useless toy that I’ll likely shelf soon and try to forget it, just like the RENPHO app has forgotten it every time I try to sync its data to see how it’s doing. My biggest issue is the blood pressure cuff. Like I said, it reads and stores locally just fine, but syncing is a major issue, so following trends is not reliable. I have to fight the device by power-cycling it, and the app at least a dozen times before it will sync, sometimes resorting to full power cycles on the phone, which normally just end with me giving up for the night/day and hoping it works the next time I take a reading. Sometimes that wait time works, but normally I end up with 2-3 day gaps of no readings recorded in the RENPHO app until it finally catches, and all the prior data is dumped at once. I s’pose I should be grateful it is remembering the prior readings, but it would be significantly better to get the data recorded when I take the reading. It makes following my trends unreliable, and will ultimately end up with me finding a superior brand, and I’ll replace all my RENPHO devices.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.text:
Had a previous issue with multiple accounts that made me think I lost all my data. User error. 

App works great for tracking weight, food/calories and such. Good value for the money considering the app is free and the scales aren’t expensive. 

I do find the calculations to be strange with “Athlete mode” being so vastly different from standard. My body fat varies by 10% depending on whether it’s on or off. I’m in good shape and exercise regularly, but I’m not sure I meet the exact criteria for athlete mode; Despite that, the standard setting’s values don’t make as much sense - I’m either 27% fat or 17%… 17% is more realistic, but I have to toggle athlete mode.

Why is there such a disparity? Shouldn’t the number be the number? 

My BMR is supposedly 1900+ calories. I’m not eating anything close to that and I’m burning an additional 500-600+ calories a day from exercise. I should be dropping weight steadily, but I’ve been maintaining for months consuming closer to 1600 and all my exercise and walking (tracked with a Polar HR monitor). So I wouldn’t recommend using the BMR recommendation as a hard and fast goal either. 

Other than that, it’s still worth it. Just check your values against reality if you’re in between athlete mode’s requirements to pick the right one.

reviews.title: Best Scale Ever- More Than Weight Loss
reviews.text: My health coach told me about the Renpho scale and app. I was surprised to find I already had a Renpho scale, just hadn’t taken the time to connect it properly to the app. What a game-changer. I’m at my goal weight, but this scale is so much more. It tracks my BMI, my subcutaneous fat, my visceral fat, my body water, my bone muscle, my skeletal muscle, and so much more! So I can see where I’m doing great and where I need to add things like strength training or endurance exercises as well. I can get comparison charts, daily changes, color-coded graphs that show my progress, etc. And the best part? It’s NOT expensive and not and not hard to figure out(I am turning 65 this month)!!

reviews.title: Great app, but…
reviews.text:
I love the kitchen scale and app! They’ve made tracking my macros much easier and more convenient. However, I’ve noticed that a lot of foods are missing from the app, and there doesn’t seem to be a way to create a recipe and then weigh the finished dish after cooking. This makes tracking meals, especially dinners that I prepare for two people, much more difficult. While I can calculate the portions manually, having a recipe feature similar to what many other nutrition apps offer would be a great improvement.

Additionally, the app would benefit from a feature that allows users to scan nutrition labels when a food item isn’t already available in the database. This would make adding custom foods faster and improve the overall user experience.

reviews.title: Goal timelines
reviews.text: It’s frustrating that you can only set a goal for 364 days. For a lot of us this will take more than a year. I don’t want to reset and lose my initial weight. I would like to see my ENTIRE progress. Don’t make me reset my goals and change my initial weight.

reviews.title: Please Restore the Measurements Section
reviews.text:
I’ve been a RENPHO user for a long time, and one of my favorite features was being able to easily track my body measurements alongside my weight. After the latest update, I can’t even find where to enter or view my measurements anymore.

The app now seems to focus almost entirely on weight and biometric data. While those metrics are valuable, they’re only part of the picture. For many of us, inches lost around the waist, hips, thighs, arms, and chest are just as important as the number on the scale, sometimes even more important.

Please bring back easy access to body measurements or make them much easier to find. A health app should make it simple to track all aspects of progress, not hide or remove features that users rely on.

The hardware is great, but this update has made the app much less useful for me. I hope the developers listen to user feedback and restore this functionality.
